Jeen launches AI spending controls as enterprises struggle with runaway agentic AI costs

#1 — Jeen Brings Real-Time Cost Control to Enterprise AI — PRNewswire

★ Directly addresses Cristiano's CTO focus on enterprise AI governance—cost control and visibility over agentic AI spending is critical for responsible scaling at Eidosmedia.

Jeen announced real-time cost governance capabilities, giving finance and IT teams continuous visibility into enterprise AI spending across the organization. The platform addresses a critical pain point: agents executing unattended can consume in an afternoon what teams consume in a month, making retroactive cost discovery obsolete.
